item.description:
RunHuddle 0.5.1 makes terminal navigation and session cleanup easier to follow.
- Terminal’s chooser now includes tabs running through shells or wrappers, with live terminal matches ranked first and title matches clearly labeled. - Opening Terminal shows progress without blocking the app. Automation permission errors include a shortcut to settings. - Detached sessions explain that their current activity is unconfirmed. - Bulk cleanup reports review and processing progress. Selection controls fit narrower lists, and cleanup results can be dismissed. - Connections scrolls on smaller screens while keeping its action buttons visible.
Validation: Swift and Python regression suites, standalone bundle verification, and signed updater installation test. Physical multi-monitor and Ghostty interaction testing remains pending.
